explanation: A fast light body (m=1) strikes a heavy body (m~19.3) head-on with near-zero restitution. The impulse plus positional correction transfers momentum but increases total mechanical energy by ~315 J in one step (98->99), exceeding the 10%+5J allowance. Likely cause: sequential impulse solver over-corrects / mis-weights mass ratio when resolving the large closing velocity with positional Baumgarte correction injecting energy, or restitution applied asymmetrically. Equal-mass counterfactual passes.
